“A typical year of incoming emails = 136 kg of carbon emissions = the equivalent of driving 320 kms in an average car.
Greenhouse gases that come from building, delivering and using digital technology = 4 per cent of the world’s global greenhouse emissions.
The level of digital pollution is double the pollution caused by the global aviation industry
15 billion smartphones = an impact of 900 million tons of CO2, 1.35 billion tons of materials and 204 billion tons of water to produce these electronic devices.

Energy = 60 per cent of total global greenhouse gas emissions. It can be in the form of stored data on servers that require energy to be active 24/7, smartphone apps, online video and audio calls and so on.”
